description: Paths printed from a working directory below the config's rootDir (B23d A3 review): Jest prints a file's header relative to the working directory (`config.cwd`, the real path of `process.cwd()`), not to `rootDir`. The runner runs in `pkg/`, with the config's rootDir the fixture's root: `pkg/a.test.ts` is `a.test.ts` and `root.test.ts` is `../root.test.ts`. The files differ in size, so Jest's first-run order (largest first) is fixed. One worker. A black-box run.
